name: agentforce-alias-url-trace
query: what API references does Agentforce publish?
hypothesis: Agentforce is catalog-missing (commit faa2f20 added it to lib/scrape/aliases.js). The cascade should: (1) attempt the /docs/apis catalog scrape, (2) miss on Agentforce, (3) read aliases.js, (4) resolve to https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/ai/agentforce/references, (5) scrape that area-landing URL. URL-trace asserts the alias-resolved URL actually reaches a Bash scrape call – proves the alias map fires end-to-end, not just that the model can read the file. Final-answer assertions guard against citation drift on a second catalog-missing product.

assertions.because: alias map must resolve 'agentforce' to the canonical references URL and that URL must reach scrape.js – cascade resolution proof, not just file-read
